hotel_name: JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America

claims.text: The hotel is attached to Mall of America.

findings.quote: Attached to Mall of America, our destination is ideal year-round!

claims.text: The hotel is located between the twin cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul, in an urban location with a suburban feel.

findings.quote: JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America is perfectly located between the twin cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul in an urban location with a suburban feel.

claims.text: Mall of America has over 520 shops and 50 restaurants under one roof.

findings.quote: It’s over 520 shops full of tax-free shopping and 50 restaurants full of delicious food and experiences – all under one roof.

claims.text: The hotel has second-floor skyway access to the mall.

findings.quote: And with second-floor skyway access to the Mall (right near the Nordstrom enrance, we might add)

claims.text: Many guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and all have deluxe bedding.

findings.quote: Many of our 342 elegantly furnished guest rooms include floor-to-ceiling windows, and they all offer deluxe bedding and a host of premium amenities.

claims.text: Every guest room has a soaking tub.

findings.quote: Every one of our 342 guest rooms are accommodated with a luxurious and peaceful soaking tub

claims.text: The Presidential Suites include a full parlor with a spacious dining table.

findings.quote: The sophisticated charm of our Presidential Suites provides an exclusive setting for private meetings
including a full parlor with a spacious dining table.

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor swimming pool.

findings.quote: Indulge in our indoor swimming pool to help revitalize your mind, body and spirit.

claims.text: The fitness studio is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

findings.quote: Open 7 days a week 24-hours a day.

claims.text: Cedar + Stone, Urban Table is inspired by Minnesota's natural surroundings and relationships with farmers within 200 miles.

findings.quote: Inspired by a fusion of culinary cultures, Minnesota's natural surroundings and relationships with farmers within 200 miles, Cedar + Stone, Urban Table creates a vibrant dining experience

claims.text: Minnesota Valley National Wildlife Refuge is less than a mile from the hotel.

findings.quote: Less than a mile from the JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America is a thriving urban refuge
Minnesota Valley National Wildlife Refuge

claims.text: The hotel is directly connected to Mall of America shopping, including brands like Nordstrom and Chanel.

findings.quote: directly connected to the incredible shopping at Mall of America, including brands like Arc’teryx, Nordstrom, BOSS, Chanel and other luxury offerings.

claims.text: Suites have Italian marble bathrooms with stand-alone tubs and separate marble showers.

findings.quote: The luxury suites are appointed with spacious bathrooms clad in Italian marble, featuring stand-alone tubs, separate marble showers

claims.text: The 15th-floor Concierge Lounge has views of the Twin Cities.

findings.quote: The 15th floor Concierge Lounge offers amazing views of the Twin Cities

claims.text: Arriving guests are met with an exclusive scent and sound created by Flamingo Estate for JW Marriott.

findings.quote: Experience the exclusive scent and sound created by Flamingo Estate for JW Marriott. The moment a guest arrives at our hotel, they are met with an herbaceous and uplifting scent and a unique sound

claims.text: Babylon Micro-Farms at Cedar + Stone grow greens and herbs steps from the table.

findings.quote: At Cedar + Stone, Urban Table, locally sourced ingredients are at the heart of every dish. Our Babylon Micro-Farms flourish just steps from your table, bringing the freshest greens and herbs straight from seed to plate.

claims.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.

findings.quote: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America.

claims.text: Downtown Minneapolis is about 10 minutes away by light rail.

findings.quote: Take the light rail over to downtown Minneapolis, just 10 minutes away, to keep the party going.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the mall location may feel commercial rather than like a traditional hotel.
